title: React cart hook
context: Shopping cart hook. The cart is saved to localStorage and a saved cart must be restored when the page loads. Prices are integer cents.
code: type Item = { sku: string; price: number; qty: number };
const total = useMemo(() => items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.price * i.qty, 0), []);

expected.why: the save effect runs first on mount and overwrites the stored cart with initial, so the saved cart is never restored
state is mutated in place and the same array is set again, so React does not re-render
empty dependency list: total is computed once and never updates when items change
